solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**₹53.50**).
solution.keyConcept: 2-Year CI − SI Difference Formula: D = P(R/100)²

steps.en: Diff is simply $R\%$ of 1st year's SI: Year-1 SI $= 5\%$ of $21,400 = 1070$, and $5\%$ of $1070 = \mathbf{53.5}$!

solution.en:
Method 1: 2-Year Difference Formula: 1) $P = 21,400$, $R = 5\%$.
2) $D_2 = 21400 \times \frac{5}{100} \times \frac{5}{100} = \mathbf{53.5}$.

Method 2: Interest-on-Interest Tree (Zero Formula): Diff is simply $R\%$ of 1st year's SI: Year-1 SI $= 5\%$ of $21,400 = 1070$, and $5\%$ of $1070 = \mathbf{53.5}$!
solution.hi:
विधि 1: 2-वर्ष CI−SI अंतर सूत्र: 1) $P = 21,400$, $R = 5\%$।
2) $D_2 = 21400 \times \frac{5^2}{10000} = \mathbf{53.5}$ रुपये।

विधि 2: केवल ब्याज-पर-ब्याज ट्री विधि: प्रथम वर्ष ब्याज $= 1070$; इसी का $5\% = \mathbf{53.5}$ ही अंतर है!

question.en: The simple interest earned on three different sums is in the ratio 5 : 7 : 9. The sums are in the ratio 10 : 14 : 15, and the time periods are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. What is the ratio of the rates of interest?
question.hi: तीन अलग - अलग राशियों पर अर्जित साधारण ब्याज का अनुपात 5 : 7 : 9 है। राशियों का अनुपात 10 : 14 : 15 है , और समय अवधि का अनुपात 3 : 4 : 5 है। ब्याज दरों का अनुपात कितना है ?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option A (**100 : 75 : 72**).
solution.keyConcept: Rate Ratio from SI, Principal & Time Ratios (R = SI / (P × T))

optionTrick.en: Compute $\frac{5}{10\times 3} : \frac{7}{14\times 4} : \frac{9}{15\times 5} = \frac{1}{6} : \frac{1}{8} : \frac{3}{25}$. First two ratio is $\frac{1}{6} : \frac{1}{8} = 4 : 3 = 100 : 75$, locking **100 : 75 : 72**!

title.en: Method 1: Ratio Formula R = SI / (P × T)
title.hi: विधि 1: अनुपात सूत्र R = SI / (P × T)
विधि 2: प्रथम दो अनुपात + सटीक अंतिम पद ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Ratio Formula R = SI / (P × T): 1) $R_1 : R_2 : R_3 = \frac{5}{10 \times 3} : \frac{7}{14 \times 4} : \frac{9}{15 \times 5} = \frac{1}{6} : \frac{1}{8} : \frac{3}{25}$.
2) Multiply by $\text{LCM}(6, 8, 25) = 600$: $100 : 75 : 72$.

Method 2: Two-Ratio Elimination (1/6 : 1/8 = 100 : 75): From $\frac{1}{6} : \frac{1}{8} = 4 : 3$, eliminate `100 : 78 : ...` immediately; compare 2nd vs 3rd: $\frac{1}{8} : \frac{3}{25} = 25 : 24 = 75 : 72 \Rightarrow$ **100 : 75 : 72**!
